title: Rigatoni with Meat Sauce
seoTitle: Rigatoni with Meat Sauce | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Slow-simmered beef and pork ragù over rigatoni for ten
subtitle: Slow-simmered beef and pork ragù over rigatoni for ten
description: Ground beef and pork simmer with onion, garlic, and crushed tomatoes until thick and rich. Toss with rigatoni and finish with Parmesan for a proper Italian-American hall feed.

steps.title: Brown the meats
steps.instruction: Cook beef and pork with onion over medium-high heat 12–15 minutes, breaking into crumbles until well browned. Drain excess fat.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.instruction: Add garlic and tomato paste, cook 2 minutes. Pour in wine and simmer until mostly reduced, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer low
steps.instruction: Add crushed tomatoes and oregano. Simmer uncovered 40–45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and oil pools at edges.

steps.title: Cook rigatoni
steps.instruction: Boil rigatoni in salted water until al dente, about 11 minutes. Drain and toss with a cup of sauce.

steps.title: Serve family-style
steps.instruction: Portion pasta into bowls or hotel pan, top with remaining sauce and Parmesan. Serve with extra cheese at the line.

proTips: A parmesan rind simmered in the sauce adds savory depth—fish it out before serving.
Red pepper flake pinch in the browning stage wakes up canned tomatoes.
Double the batch and freeze half sauce for an emergency pasta night.
tonightSpread: Rigatoni with meat sauce, garlic bread, and simple green salad.
Roasted zucchini on the side for crew who want vegetables.
leftovers: Bake into a pasta casserole with extra mozzarella on top.
Stuff into hoagie rolls with melted provolone for meatball-less subs.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Meat sauce is the pasta baseline everyone recognizes. It scales cheap, simmers while you handle other duties, and holds hot in a hotel pan for late eaters.
mealPrepNotes: Simmer sauce at least 45 minutes for depth—longer is better. Salt pasta water heavily. Sauce and pasta can stay separate until service if holding.
